gemini_description.purpose: To illustrate the proper method for anchoring a water pump to a concrete foundation.
gemini_description.summary: This diagram (Fig. 1) provides the technical details for securing a pump unit's mounting base to a solid concrete floor or slab. It features a side-profile view of the pump assembly and a detailed sectional close-up of a J-shaped/L-shaped anchor bolt embedded in concrete, securing the pump foot with a washer and nut.

components.name: Water Pump Assembly
components.description: The main pump unit, including the pump body, motor, suction inlet, and discharge outlet.

components.name: Suction/Inlet Pipe
components.description: Horizontal pipe connection on the left side of the pump body.

components.name: Discharge/Outlet Pipe
components.description: Vertical pipe connection on the top of the pump body.

components.name: Anchor Bolt
components.description: An L-shaped or J-shaped threaded metal bolt embedded in the concrete foundation to resist pull-out forces.

components.name: Concrete Foundation
components.description: The solid slab or floor base that supports the weight of the pump and absorbs operational vibrations.

components.name: Nut and Washer
components.description: Fasteners used to clamp the pump's mounting foot down onto the concrete base via the threaded end of the anchor bolt.

components.name: Pump Mounting Foot
components.description: The integral flange or foot at the base of the pump housing designed with an opening for the anchoring fastener.

procedure: Locate the designated anchoring points on the mounting feet at the base of the pump.
Prepare the concrete foundation with embedded L-shaped or J-shaped anchor bolts positioned to match the mounting foot hole centers.
Place the pump assembly onto the concrete foundation, ensuring the threaded ends of the anchor bolts protrude through the holes in the mounting feet.
Install a washer over each protruding threaded bolt.
Thread and tighten the hex nut onto the bolt to secure the pump firmly to the foundation, preventing movement and minimizing vibration during operation.

technical_details.detail: The anchor detail uses a hook-type anchor bolt (J-bolt or L-bolt) embedded directly into the concrete base to maximize pull-out resistance.
A washer is placed beneath the nut to distribute the clamping force evenly across the plastic or metal mounting flange of the pump.
The diagram includes multilingual labels for 'Anchor Detail' in English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, Portuguese, Greek, Russian, and Arabic.

warnings.warning: The concrete base must be fully cured and solid before tightening the anchor bolts to prevent cracking or anchor failure.
Do not overtighten the nut, as excessive torque may crack or damage the pump's integrated mounting foot.
